propositions: A single criterion's evidence run exhausting its budget currently aborts the entire recovery process instead of preserving partial evidence from other criteria.

When one evidence agent hits LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, or token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError, the per-criterion loop discards all gathered evidence and raises an exception that halts recovery.

The finalizer should receive evidence entries for all criteria, with exhausted criteria marked with a content-free placeholder indicating evidence could not be gathered within bounds, allowing verdicts to be computed across partial evidence.
Recovery should fail outright only when all criteria's evidence runs fail, not when a single criterion exhausts its budget; successful-evidence behavior must remain unchanged.
A content-free placeholder entry must never be interpretable as affirmative evidence and must include the failure class name and numeric usage counters as diagnostic information.
